name: E+A galaxy EA13 (Hubble)
blurb: EA13, a post-starburst (E+A) galaxy from the Las Campanas Redshift Survey, seen by Hubble.
label: gal111952125239-hubble
story: Post-starburst galaxies like this one are among the best candidates for galaxies in transition, turning from gas-rich and star-forming to gas-poor and passively evolving through galaxy mergers. This one lives in the field, away from galaxy clusters.

claims.text: The target position (11 19 52, -12 52 39) is the LCRS E+A galaxy lcrs13, in a field environment
Galaxy 13 of the Zabludoff et al. (1996) E+A sample lies at B1950 11 17 21.50 -12 36 13.3
Post-starburst (E+A) galaxies are the best candidates for galaxies in transition from gas-rich and star-forming to gas-poor and passively evolving, via galaxy mergers
The E+A galaxies EA06 to EA21 of the Zabludoff et al. (1996) Las Campanas Redshift Survey sample were imaged with Hubble's ACS
